blocks.title: if statement
blocks.text: The if statement runs a block of code only if its condition is true.

blocks.title: Python code (each .... is one 4-space indent)

blocks.text: Here the condition temperature > 30 is true, so the message is printed. The indented line under the colon is the block that belongs to the if.

blocks.prompt: What does the program print if temperature is 25?
blocks.explanation: Nothing: the condition is false, so the block is skipped.

items: if condition: runs the indented block only when the condition is true.
